findings.title: onApprove handler returns void — misrouted approvals silently succeed
findings.detail: In src/server.ts, onApprove logged an error but returned void. The control plane saw a resolved handler and returned HTTP 202 Accepted. Operators routing /approve to port 3001 got a success response while the task remained blocked in architect wait state. Mirrors the onCancel pattern that was already fixed to throw.
findings.fix_sketch: Mirror onCancel: throw new Error('approve is daemon-only; route to CONTROL_PLANE_PORT 3002'). FIXED.

findings.title: git commit failure swallowed in editor — caller sees misleading no-diff error
findings.detail: In src/pipeline/editor.ts, failed git commit only emitted console.warn and returned normally. The caller computed no committed diff and logged a misleading 'editor produced no diff — possible silent tool-use failure'. The actual commit error (identity not configured, locked index, etc.) was hidden, and staged changes were never committed.
findings.fix_sketch: Re-throw on commit failure: same pattern as AUDIT-IFleet-e5f6a7b8 for git add. FIXED.

findings.title: runTickLoop fire-and-forget void — unhandled rejection silently terminates daemon
findings.detail: In src/orchestrator/daemon.ts, void runTickLoop(...) had no .catch() handler. In Node.js 15+, an unhandled promise rejection from the tick loop causes a fatal process crash with no logged context. The sleep() call on line 126 was outside the try/catch, so any unexpected rejection would escape silently.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace void with .catch((err) => { console.error(...); process.exit(1); }). FIXED.

findings.title: DockerSandboxRunner runCommand inherits full process.env including all secrets
findings.detail: In src/agents/verifier/sandbox.ts, runCommand() created SpawnOptions without setting env, so git clone/checkout and docker subprocesses inherited the full daemon process.env including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, IFLEET_HMAC_SECRET, and GITHUB_TOKEN. This contrasted with InvariantRunner.runCommand which explicitly sets env: verifyChildEnv().
findings.fix_sketch: Apply env: verifyChildEnv() to SpawnOptions in DockerSandboxRunner.runCommand. FIXED.

findings.title: discardRawLog exported but never called — verifier temp dirs accumulate indefinitely
findings.detail: In src/agents/verifier/sandbox.ts, uploadLog() creates a mkdtemp directory per verifier run. discardRawLog() was exported as the cleanup function but had no call sites outside its definition. On long-running daemons with many verifier runs, /tmp filled with ifleet-verifier-* directories.
findings.fix_sketch: Import discardRawLog in controller.ts and call it after bridge.completeRun(merged). FIXED.

findings.title: handleAuditFix catch block swallows dispatch error — failure reason invisible
findings.detail: In packages/orchestrator-core/src/discord/handlers/interaction-create.ts, the catch block on controlPlane.postCommand discarded the error entirely (catch { failed.push(finding.id) }). Discord reported a count of failed findings but no reason, making network errors, auth failures, or malformed payloads invisible to operators.
findings.fix_sketch: Log the caught error before pushing to failed array. FIXED.

findings.title: MCP submit-sprint brief has no max length — GitHub silently truncates beyond 65536 chars
findings.detail: In src/mcp/tools/submit-sprint.ts, the brief field was validated only as z.string().min(1). An MCP client could submit arbitrarily large briefs. GitHub caps issue bodies at 65,536 characters and silently truncates beyond that, so workers see a different (shorter) description than what was submitted.
findings.fix_sketch: Add .max(65000, 'brief must not exceed 65,000 characters (GitHub issue body limit)') to Zod schema. FIXED.

findings.title: statusToEventKind returns string not narrowed union — loses type safety on event kind
findings.detail: In src/agents/verifier/controller.ts, statusToEventKind was typed to return string. All four return values are string literals for verifier event kinds. Returning string lost type safety and autocomplete for callers.

findings.title: noopQueue watchForNew stop arrow returns undefined not void — type mismatch
findings.detail: In src/server.ts, noopQueue() implemented watchForNew's stop as () => undefined (return type () => undefined) rather than () => void as the QueueAdapter interface expects. Also lacked a comment explaining why a noop queue is needed, risking removal as dead code.
findings.fix_sketch: Change to stop: () => { /* no-op */ } and add explanatory comment. FIXED.

findings.title: Package imports cross package boundary via deep relative path traversals
findings.detail: interaction-create.ts imports ../../../../../src/audit/audit-store.js and ../../../../../src/orchestrator/approval-gate.js, escaping packages/orchestrator-core/ into main src/. Breaks monorepo isolation and creates fragile path resolution.
findings.fix_sketch: Expose required functions as a proper package dependency replacing relative path escapes with package imports.
